meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw agent 安装 Vercel CLI，并在 OneCLI 里为 api.vercel.com 配置 Vercel 凭据注入；装好后 agent 就能把 web 应用部署到 Vercel。
howto.when: 当你希望 agent 能把 web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。前提是 OneCLI 已就绪，否则先运行 /init-onecli，再重试 /add-vercel。

say.note: 安装 Vercel CLI 并配置凭据注入

say.text: 检查一下 Vercel 部署能力是不是已经装好了
say.note: 检查容器技能与 Dockerfile 安装项

howto.what_en: Installs the Vercel CLI into NanoClaw agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com, so agents can deploy web applications to Vercel.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want agents to deploy web applications to Vercel. Requires OneCLI to be working; if it is missing, run /init-onecli first, then retry /add-vercel.

say_en.text: Set up Vercel deployment for my agents
say_en.note: Installs the Vercel CLI and configures credential injection
